en.title: Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) Explained Simply
en.directAnswer: Tax deducted at source means a payer withholds tax from a payment before giving you the balance. Depending on the current law, that deduction may count toward your final tax or have another treatment. Always keep the certificate or proof because rates and treatment differ by payment type.

atAGlance.whoFor: A citizen sees tax deducted before receiving money and wants to understand it.

en.lawMeaning:
Do not publish a universal TDS rate. Salary, professional fees, bank interest, contracts and other payments can have different rules.

This page gives a general route. A person’s exact rights can change because of facts, documents, deadlines, legal status, court orders or later amendments.
